title: Mealime Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mealime:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for mealime metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for mealime metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It treats the smoothed week-long trend in your value from mealime metric0.
